title: Easy Vanilla Sit
description: Let you sit everywhere or create chairs easily and quickly!
body:
Use **/trigger sit** to sit once wherever you want

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/gStqUCIt0xg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

____

Use **/trigger chair** to summon a chair which you can right click on to sit
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Osz_EkVtIow" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

_____

Use **/trigger kill_chair** to delete a chair you dont want
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4pGvlK1PR38" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

_____

In creative mod to can use **/trigger chair_give_spawn_egg** to get a spawn egg that spawns a chair
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/1Tqfrw4vfew" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
